_what: What contracts 136.0.0-144.0.0 moved in the metric roster, measured 2026-10-30 by the re-extraction at 144.0.0 (302 metrics; refresh_metric_contracts.py reported retired ['BB_WIDTH', 'STOCH_RSI14'] and 302 written). `retired` names what the corpus of 2026-10-26 held and the 144.0.0 stage schema's $defs/metricKey no longer accepts (each refused live 2026-10-30, data/audit/relative_to_probe_144_2026-10-30.json); `retiredBetweenExtractions` two keys that were added and retired between the two captures, never in any OMEGA corpus; `added` the 78 keys the vendor changelog documents at v136.1, v137, v137.2, v137.3 and v138, plus two (ROC9, SQZ_MOM) no changelog entry names; details are the served hints (get_metric_construction_hints, 2026-10-30). `transformsAdded` is v142.3's relativeTo; `columnKnobsAdded` v136's `scope` and v142.3's `instrument`; `unitsAdded` v137's `points` and v142.3's `priceRatio` (each measured in data/audit/relative_to_probe_144_2026-10-30.json).

BB_WIDTH.author: BB_WIDTH_PCT
BB_WIDTH.quote: README v138 "Retired - the reason v138 is MAJOR": `BB_WIDTH` (header `BBwidth20`) is gone from every authoring input. It was the Bollinger band spread in price units, which TradingView does not publish. Use `BB_WIDTH_PCT` (`bbWidthPct`), TradingView's Bollinger BandWidth `ta.bbw`.
BB_WIDTH.measured: BB_WIDTH x value refused 2026-10-30 at 144.0.0 (the key is not in $defs/metricKey)

SPOT_CLOSE_BYB.quote: README v140: `SPOT_CLOSE_BYB` (header `bybClose`, Bybit's spot close) is gone from every authoring input, and so is every header derived from it. Bybit's own record cannot recover a minute its feed missed, so it is no longer a spot venue.

BUY_PRES_BYB.quote: README v139: `BUY_PRES_BYB` (header `bybBuyPres`, Bybit's taker-buy share) is gone from every authoring input, and so is every header derived from it. Bybit publishes no trade history, so a minute its feed missed could never be recovered.

BUY_PRES_BN.gloss: buy share of Binance's spot volume in the bar's period (0–1), from the venue's taker sides

BUY_PRES_CB.gloss: buy share of Coinbase's spot volume in the bar's period (0–1), from the venue's taker sides

BUY_QUOTE_VOL.gloss: the bar's buy-side traded notional, in USD: the sum of each taker buy's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

CUM_VOLUME_DELTA.gloss: TradingView's cumulative volume delta — each intrabar's volume signed by its close against its open, then against the previous intrabar's close, summed since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor; intrabars are 1m on minute and hour rungs and 5m on 1d

MONTH_TPO_POC.gloss: the price bin holding the most time of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile

MONTH_TPO_VAH.gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile

MONTH_TPO_VAL.gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area of the current UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one 5-bps grid anchored at the period's opening price — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the period's first 60 minutes and while any earlier day of the period has no stored profile

PMH.gloss: the high of the previous completed UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

PML.gloss: the low of the previous completed UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

PRIOR_MONTH_TPO_POC.gloss: the price bin that held the most time of the previous completed UTC month, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

QUOTE_VOL.gloss: the bar's traded notional, in USD: the sum of each trade's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

ROC9.source: undocumented (no README 'Contract history' entry names it; served at 144.0.0 and read from the hints)
ROC9.gloss: rate of change vs 9 bars ago (%)

SELL_QUOTE_VOL.gloss: the bar's sell-side traded notional, in USD: the sum of each taker sell's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

SPOT_AVG_TRADE.gloss: the composite spot volume per trade in the bar's period, over the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase), in this coin's own unit; absent where one of those venues did not cover the period or nothing traded

SPOT_DOMINANCE.gloss: the composite spot volume, over the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase), as a share of composite spot plus the bar's perp volume, both in this coin's own unit (0–1); absent where one of those venues did not cover the period

SQZ_MOM.source: undocumented (no README 'Contract history' entry names it; served at 144.0.0 and read from the hints)
SQZ_MOM.gloss: LazyBear's squeeze momentum — the 20-bar linear regression end point of the close's distance from the average of the 20-bar Donchian midline and simple mean, in price units: the direction a TTM squeeze releases

STOCH_RSI_D.gloss: Stoch RSI %D — the 3-bar mean of Stoch RSI %K, its signal line

STOCH_RSI_K.gloss: Stoch RSI %K (14,14,3,3) — where RSI(14) sits in its own 14-bar range, 0–100, smoothed over 3 bars
